data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to process Paystack payments on mobile and web with split and subscription support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified API to initialize, display and verify Paystack transactions on Android, iOS and Web. Supports card, bank, USSD, mobile money, QR, split payments and subscription plans. Can work with client‑side secret key or server‑side authorization URL.
use_when: you need Paystack payment integration for Android, iOS, or Web
you require split‑payment or subscription capabilities
avoid_when: you use a different payment gateway (e.g., Stripe, Adyen)
you need native in‑app purchases from Google Play or App Store
strengths: mobile and web support in one package
offers both client‑side and server‑side initialization
weaknesses: requires manual JavaScript interop for web
client‑side secret key handling can be insecure
data.setup_notes: Add web/paystack_interop.js and include Paystack script in web/index.html; set Android minSdkVersion >=19; no extra iOS steps; provide secretKey or authorizationUrl at runtime

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a broader set of payment methods and is backed by Stripe, a widely used gateway

data.minimal_example:
await FlutterPaystackPlus.openPaystackPopup(
  context: context,
  customerEmail: 'customer@example.com',
  amount: '50000',
  reference: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
  secretKey: 'sk_live_your_secret_key',
  callBackUrl: 'https://your-callback-url.com',
  onSuccess: () => debugPrint('Payment successful!'),
  onClosed: () => debugPrint('Payment cancelled.'),
);
